dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened to the addendum to the announcement?

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: The Matsuura Clan have already sent someone to handle that. Currently, everyone thinks that it was all a big misunderstanding.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: There are still some ill-favored rumors going about, but I believe that they will disappear given time.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: I will keep a close eye on that. Hopefully, nothing similar happens in the future.
